1.w: And Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:

2.w: “Can a man be useful to God? Can even a wise one benefit Him?

3.w: Is it pleasure to Shaddai that you are righteous, or gain that you perfect your ways?

4.w: For your fear does He rebuke you and enter against you into judgment?

5.w: Is not your evil great, and your iniquity without end?

6.w: For you take a pledge from your brothers needlessly, and the garments the naked you strip off.

7.w: You have not quenched with water the weary, and from the hungry you have withheld bread.

8.w: But the man of arm, unto him [is] the land, and the uplifted of face, he dwells in it!

9.w: You have sent away widows in emptiness, and the arms of the fatherless are crushed.

10.w: Upon thus [there are] snares all around you, and dread suddenly terrifies you,

11.w: or darkness you cannot see, and an abundance of waters covers you.

12.w: Is not God in the height of the heavens? And behold, the head of the stars, how exalted they are!

13.w: And you say, ‘What does God know? [How] can He judge through the dark cloud?

14.w: Clouds are a covering for Him, so that He does not see, and the vault of the heavens He walks about.’

15.w: Will you keep the way of old, which men of iniquity have trod,

16.w: who were seized, and [it was] not time, their foundation was poured out [by] a torrent?

17.w: They said to God, ‘Turn away from us!’ And’What can Shaddai do to [us]?’

18.w: Yet He filled their houses [with] good—and the counsel of the wicked, may it be far from me!

19.w: The righteous see [it] and are glad, and the innocent one mocks them:

20.w: ‘Surely our adversaries cut off, and fire consumes their excess.’

21.w: Make yourself of use now, and be at peace with Him; with these [things] will come to you good.

22.w: Receive, please, instruction from His mouth, and set His words in your heart.

23.w: If you should return to Shaddai, you will be built up, [if] you put far away from your tent iniquity,

24.w: and [if] you set your gold upon the dust, and Ophir among the stones of the torrents,

25.w: then Shaddai will be your gold, and the silver of heights for you.

26.w: For then you will take delight in Shaddai, and you will lift to God your face.

27.w: You will pray to Him, and He will hear you, and your vows you will fulfill.

28.w: Then you will decree a word, and it will stand for you, and upon your paths light will shine.

29.w: When they have made low, and you say Lift up, then the lowly of eyes He will save.

30.w: He will deliver the one not innocent, rescuing him by the purity of your hands.”
